name: Wyvern's Tail
summary: The Wyvern's Tail is a cozy tavern and inn tucked away in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor. Situated near the valley's quiet pool, it offers weary warriors and travelers a warm drink and a place to rest away from the bustling thoroughfares of the Valley of Strength.

sections.title: Rest in the Valley of Honor
sections.body: While most travelers arriving in Orgrimmar settle in the central Valley of Strength, the Wyvern's Tail serves the martial district of the Valley of Honor. Positioned beside the valley's serene pond and beneath the red canyon bluffs, the tavern features sturdy tables for feasting and private quarters for weary brawlers and soldiers seeking to recuperate after grueling training in the nearby ring.

faq.q: Where is the Wyvern's Tail located?
faq.answer: The Wyvern's Tail is located in the northeastern section of Orgrimmar, inside the Valley of Honor. It sits close to the district's water pool and warrior training grounds.

faq.q: What services does the Wyvern's Tail provide?
faq.answer: It serves as a functional tavern and inn for the Horde. Adventurers can bind their Hearthstone to the innkeeper, purchase food and drink, and rest away from the crowded city center.

faq.q: Why stay here instead of the main inn?
aliases: wyverns tail vs valley of strength inn
faq.answer: The Valley of Strength inn is often crowded and chaotic. The Wyvern's Tail provides a quieter, more peaceful atmosphere near the water, popular among veterans, hunters, and fighters training in the Valley of Honor.

angles.text: Located right beside the warrior trainers and dueling grounds of the Valley of Honor, this inn is the natural spot to nurse battle bruises and share war stories.
For travelers looking to escape the relentless heat and bustle of Orgrimmar's main gate, the Wyvern's Tail offers a tranquil waterside respite within the capital's fortified walls.
